# Streamlabs Desktop sub-actions

## Flip source

Mirrors a source sideways or upside down. Running it again flips it back.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Scene** | The scene name exactly as Streamlabs Desktop shows it, like "Just Chatting". |
| **Source** | The source name exactly as Streamlabs Desktop shows it, like "Webcam". |
| **Axis** | Horizontal mirrors left and right, Vertical turns it upside down. Options: Horizontal, Vertical. Starts as: `Horizontal`. |

<small>Type id: `slobs.flipSource`</small>

## Get current scene

Finds out which scene Streamlabs Desktop is showing and keeps its name for later steps.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Store result in argument** | The name of the variable that will hold the scene name, so later steps can use it as %name%. The default is slobsScene. Leave empty to not keep it. Starts as: `slobsScene`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%slobsScene%` | The scene that is showing now (or the name you chose above) |
| `%currentScene%` | The same scene name |

<small>Type id: `slobs.getCurrentScene`</small>

## Hide all scene sources

Hides every source in a scene at once.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Scene** | The scene name exactly as Streamlabs Desktop shows it, like "Just Chatting". |

<small>Type id: `slobs.hideSceneSources`</small>

## Hide group's sources

Hides every source inside a group (a folder of sources) at once.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Scene** | The scene name exactly as Streamlabs Desktop shows it, like "Just Chatting". |
| **Group** | The name of the group (a folder of sources) in that scene. |

<small>Type id: `slobs.hideGroupSources`</small>

## Hide source's filters

Turns off every filter on one source in a scene.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Scene** | The scene name exactly as Streamlabs Desktop shows it, like "Just Chatting". |
| **Source** | The source name exactly as Streamlabs Desktop shows it, like "Webcam". |

<small>Type id: `slobs.hideSourceFilters`</small>

## Raw API call

Sends Streamlabs Desktop one command of your own and keeps the answer. For advanced users who know its remote control commands.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Resource** | The part of Streamlabs Desktop to talk to, like "ScenesService". Starts as: `ScenesService`. |
| **Method** | The command to run on it, like "getScenes". Starts as: `getScenes`. |
| **Arguments (JSON array)** | Extra details for the command, written as a JSON list like ["abc"]. Leave empty if it needs none. |
| **Store result in argument** | The name of the variable that will hold the answer as text. The default is slobsResult. Leave empty to not keep it. Starts as: `slobsResult`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%slobsResult%` | The answer as JSON text (or the name you chose above) |

<small>Type id: `slobs.raw`</small>

## Recording

Starts or stops your recording in Streamlabs Desktop.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Mode** | Start begins recording, Stop ends it, Toggle does the opposite of what it is doing now. Options: Start, Stop, Toggle. Starts as: `Start`. |

<small>Type id: `slobs.recording`</small>

## Replay buffer

Starts or stops the replay buffer, or saves the last moments as a clip.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Mode** | Start and Stop turn the buffer on or off, Toggle flips it, Save keeps the last few moments as a file. Options: Start, Stop, Toggle, Save. Starts as: `Save`. |

<small>Type id: `slobs.replayBuffer`</small>

## Rotate source

Turns a source to an angle. Fun for spinning an image.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Scene** | The scene name exactly as Streamlabs Desktop shows it, like "Just Chatting". |
| **Source** | The source name exactly as Streamlabs Desktop shows it, like "Webcam". |
| **Degrees** | The angle to set, in degrees: 90 is a quarter turn, 180 is upside down. It sets the angle, it does not add to the current one. Starts as: `90`. |

<small>Type id: `slobs.rotateSource`</small>

## Set active scene

Switches Streamlabs Desktop to another scene.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Scene** | The scene name exactly as Streamlabs Desktop shows it, like "Just Chatting". |

<small>Type id: `slobs.setScene`</small>

## Set browser source URL

Makes a browser source open a different web page.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Browser source** | The browser source name exactly as Streamlabs Desktop shows it. |
| **URL** | The web address to open, like "https://example.com/alert". |

<small>Type id: `slobs.setBrowserUrl`</small>

## Set GDI text

Changes the words shown by a text source. Handy for "latest follower" or a message on screen.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Text source** | The text source name (a GDI text source) exactly as Streamlabs Desktop shows it. |
| **Text** | The words to show. You can use %variables% here. |

<small>Type id: `slobs.setText`</small>

## Set random group source visible

Shows one randomly picked source in a group and hides the others. Fun for random reactions or images.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Scene** | The scene name exactly as Streamlabs Desktop shows it, like "Just Chatting". |
| **Group** | The name of the group (a folder of sources) in that scene. |
| **Store source name in argument** | The name of the variable that will hold the picked source's name. The default is randomSource. Leave empty to not keep it. Starts as: `randomSource`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%randomSource%` | The name of the source that was picked (or the name you chose above) |

<small>Type id: `slobs.randomGroupSource`</small>

## Set scene filter state

Shows, hides or flips a filter that sits on a whole scene.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Scene** | The scene name exactly as Streamlabs Desktop shows it, like "Just Chatting". |
| **Filter** | The filter name exactly as shown. |
| **State** | Visible turns it on, Hidden turns it off, Toggle flips it. Options: Visible, Hidden, Toggle. Starts as: `Toggle`. |

<small>Type id: `slobs.setSceneFilterState`</small>

## Set source filter state

Turns a filter (an effect on a source) on or off.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Source or scene** | The source or scene the filter is on, exactly as Streamlabs Desktop shows it. |
| **Filter** | The filter name exactly as shown, like "Color Correction". |
| **State** | Enable turns it on, Disable turns it off. Options: Enable, Disable. Starts as: `Enable`. |

<small>Type id: `slobs.setFilterState`</small>

## Set source mute state

Mutes or unmutes an audio source, like your microphone.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Source** | The audio source name exactly as Streamlabs Desktop shows it, like "Mic/Aux". |
| **State** | Mute silences it, Unmute turns the sound back on, Toggle flips it. Options: Mute, Unmute, Toggle. Starts as: `Toggle`. |

<small>Type id: `slobs.setSourceMute`</small>

## Set source visibility state

Shows or hides one source (like a camera or image) inside a scene.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Scene** | The scene name exactly as Streamlabs Desktop shows it, like "Just Chatting". |
| **Source** | The source name exactly as Streamlabs Desktop shows it, like "Webcam". |
| **State** | Visible shows it, Hidden hides it, Toggle flips it. Options: Visible, Hidden, Toggle. Starts as: `Toggle`. |

<small>Type id: `slobs.setSourceVisibility`</small>

## Set state of a random filter

Picks one random filter on a source (or on the scene) and shows, hides or flips it. Fun for random effects.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Scene** | The scene name exactly as Streamlabs Desktop shows it, like "Just Chatting". |
| **Source (empty for the scene's own filters)** | The source whose filters to pick from. Leave empty to pick from the scene's own filters. |
| **State** | What to do with the picked filter: Visible, Hidden or Toggle. Options: Visible, Hidden, Toggle. Starts as: `Visible`. |
| **Store filter name in argument** | The name of the variable that will hold the picked filter's name. The default is slobsFilterName. Leave empty to not keep it. Starts as: `slobsFilterName`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%slobsFilterName%` | The name of the filter that was picked (or the name you chose above) |

<small>Type id: `slobs.setRandomFilterState`</small>

## Streaming

Starts or stops your stream in Streamlabs Desktop.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Mode** | Start begins streaming, Stop ends it, Toggle does the opposite of what it is doing now. Start does nothing if you are already streaming. Options: Start, Stop, Toggle. Starts as: `Start`. |

<small>Type id: `slobs.streaming`</small>
